keyword.zh: 电动75-60混凝土泵是哪一页

title.en: What the Electric 75-60 Alias Refers To
title.zh: 电动75-60这个别名指哪一页

description.en: Electric 75-60 is printed on the Electric Low Pressure 60 page beside a 75 kW motor. It is not a second machine and it is not Electric 60.
description.zh: 电动75-60印在电动低压60页面上，旁边是 75 kW 电机。它不是第二台机器，也不是电动60。

h1.en: What the Electric 75-60 Alias Refers To
h1.zh: 电动75-60这个别名指哪一页

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints the model line Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60 on one concrete pump page in Xingtai. The motor on that page is 75 kW. Output is 35 m³/h and outlet pressure is 30 MPa. Electric 60 is a different page, with 90 kW and 40 m³/h. The alias does not create a second specification table, and the numeral 75 matches the printed motor kilowatts rather than a separate output.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的一页混凝土泵上印了型号行：电动低压60 / 电动75-60。该页电机是 75 kW。产量 35 m³/h，出口压力 30 MPa。电动60是另一页，为 90 kW 和 40 m³/h。这个别名不会再生成第二套规格表。数字 75 对上的是印出的电机千瓦，而不是另一个产量。

body.en: The model cell contains both names. Fine-stone distance on this page is 150 m / 350 m, with further rows for 13 mm and 24 mm stone. Hopper capacity is 0.5 m³. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print those cells again under a lone 75-60 title.
body.zh: 型号格里同时有两个名称。这一页的细石距离是 150 m / 350 m，另有 13 mm 和 24 mm 石子行。料斗容积 0.5 m³。河北品锦机械没有在单独的 75-60 标题下把这些格子再印一遍。

body.en: Electric 60 prints 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa and fine-stone 200 m / 600 m. Sharing the digit 60 does not merge the pages. Open /en/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/ when the alias is what you were given.
body.zh: 电动60印 90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa、细石 200 m / 600 m。都有数字 60 也不能合并页面。如果你拿到的是这个别名，请打开 /zh/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/。

body.en: The motor power cell prints 75 kW. The output cell prints 35 m³/h. Do not read 75 as m³/h. The hydraulic pump name on this page is Kawasaki double pump 100.
body.zh: 电机功率格印 75 kW。产量格印 35 m³/h。不要把 75 读成 m³/h。这一页的液压泵名称是川崎双泵100。

question.en: Is the motor 75 kW or 60 kW?
question.zh: 电机是 75 kW 还是 60 kW？

answer.zh: 不是。理论输送量是 35 m³/h。

question.en: Does the alias have its own distance?

answer.en: No. Use the distance rows printed once on that concrete pump page.
answer.zh: 没有。使用这台混凝土泵页面上只印一次的距离行。
